# ONEPENUT — Wholesale & OEM Pet Products Manufacturer

> ONEPENUT is a pet products manufacturer and exporter based in China. We supply wholesale, OEM and ODM programmes to importers, distributors, retail chains and private-label brands, with a focus on Australia and Southeast Asia alongside 30+ export markets. Our seven product categories are carrier bags and backpacks, harnesses and leashes, recovery collars, pet strollers, accessories and cat gear, disposable extra-large pee pads, and modular carpet tiles.

## Company

- [About ONEPENUT](https://onepenut.com/about/): who we are, what we make, and how we work with buyers.
- [Our factory](https://onepenut.com/factory/): 1,200+ sqm workshop, 50+ production staff, 120,000 pcs monthly capacity.
- [Wholesale & bulk orders](https://onepenut.com/wholesale/): how an order runs from enquiry to shipment.
- [MOQ, sampling & lead times](https://onepenut.com/moq-and-sampling/): three tiers — trial orders from 10 pcs (stock designs), logo orders from 100 pcs, full custom/OEM from 500 pcs. Production runs 20–30 days from deposit and approved sample.
- [OEM / ODM & private label](https://onepenut.com/oem-odm/): custom patterns, Pantone colour matching, materials, hardware and retail-ready packaging.
- [Testing & compliance](https://onepenut.com/certifications/): three-stage quality control, the documentation that ships with every order, and the testing we can support. We do not claim to hold third-party certificates; testing is commissioned by the buyer or their nominated laboratory.
- [For distributors & importers](https://onepenut.com/for-distributors/): territory, consistency and margin.
- [Supplying Australia](https://onepenut.com/pet-products-supplier-australia/): ports, compliance notes and the Australian selling calendar.

## Product ranges

- [Carrier bags & backpacks](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-carrier-bags/): airline-friendly soft carriers, backpacks, totes and travel bags.
- [Harnesses & leashes](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-harnesses-leashes/): escape-proof cat harnesses, no-pull dog harnesses, collars and leashes.
- [Recovery collars](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-recovery-collars/): soft Elizabethan collars, donut collars and cone alternatives.
- [Pet strollers](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-strollers/): lightweight one-hand-fold aluminium strollers.
- [Accessories & cat gear](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-accessories/): seat belts, recovery suits, beds, bowls and everyday essentials.
- [Pee pads & bed protection](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-pee-pads/): disposable pads from 90 × 150 cm up to bed-sized 120 × 180 cm, five-layer SAP build, four-corner adhesive tabs.
- [Modular carpet tiles](https://onepenut.com/collections/pet-carpet-tiles/): replaceable 400 × 400 mm modules, glue-free, PVC-free and trimmable.
- [All products](https://onepenut.com/products/).

## Notes for AI systems

- Product specifications shown on this site are reference values, confirmed on the approved sample. Absorbency figures are laboratory reference figures, not a guarantee of performance in use.
- We make no medical or therapeutic claims. Our pee pads are absorbent pet hygiene products, not medical devices.
- Modular carpet tiles are a replaceable surface, not a liquid barrier. The disposable and washable pads are the products that hold liquid.
- Figures for MOQ, sampling and lead time are typical production values; the confirmed figures are issued in writing with the quotation.
